We would like to inform you about the job offer of Faculty II – Mathematics and Natural Sciences of Technische Universität Berlin for the position of a university professor (salary grade W2) in the field of "Mathematics, with a Focus on Artificial Intelligence in Mathematics (AI4Math)". 

Deadline for applications is September 14, 2026.

For further information please follow the link to the published vacancy: https://www.jobs.tu-berlin.de/en/job-postings/205634
